author: World of Warcraft
description:
Welcome to the Mythic Dungeon International 2026, where the world’s top teams clash in a high-speed, head-to-head race through the World of Warcraft: Midnight Season 1 dungeons.

24 elite teams from across the globe have earned their place—but only the best will secure a coveted spot at BlizzCon 2026. Watch live as competitors push precision, coordination, and strategy to the limit in the return of the MDI’s iconic speedrunning format.

Who will rise. Who will fall. And who will claim their place on the BlizzCon stage?

Follow the action and stay up to date:
► Full Viewer’s Guide: https://blizz.ly/3P1qB2k

► Raider.IO Tournament Bracket: https://rio.gg/mdi_mdns1_groupb

► Competitor Builds & Talents: https://mdi.gcd.tv/
